-----Original Message-----
From: Mandy Castano <Mandy.Castano@halcyonbank.co.uk>
Sent: 02 May 2025 17:46
To: Christian Thompson
Subject: Document Retention Policy

Christian: We have learned from Stephen Patterson that you are in the process of updating Credit Risk's document retention policy. What will the policy be with regard to retaining drafts of lending agreements after a particular transaction has closed? It is our understanding that Credit Risk's current policy is to discard all drafts post-closing. We are in the process of formalizing our own document retention policy at Sovereign Trust plc, and want to ensure that our practices line up with Credit Risk's. Please advise. Mandy (Sovereign Trust plc Legal)
</quoted>
